portal_host_prerequisite.message: PortalHost is a prerequisite: components/ai/context.tsx portals through @rn-primitives/portal (components/ui/popover.tsx → PopoverPrimitive.Portal); this app's root layout mounts NO PortalHost, and the primitive renders portal children only under a mounted host — without one the context surface renders NOTHING with no error. Mount <PortalHost /> from @rn-primitives/portal at the app root. The behavioral positive (popover renders through the root PortalHost) is proven by install-core.test.sh: tapOn context-trigger → assertVisible context-popover-content.
portal_host_prerequisite.behavioral_positive_proof: install-core.test.sh cold-boot flow: tapOn context-trigger -> assertVisible context-popover-content on the clean app (PortalHost mounted at apps/example/app/_layout.tsx)
